headline_before: Clinician, trainer and a voice for
intro: Philip Dimka is a clinical psychologist, trauma therapist and play therapist based in Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria. He works with adults, adolescents, children and families, and trains the people who care for them.
story_title: Why this work matters to me
story:
[Your story in your own words: what drew you to psychology, and the moment you knew trauma and children's mental health would be your life's work.]

Much of Philip's work is with conflict-affected and displaced communities in North Central Nigeria, where pain is often carried quietly and help is hard to reach. He moves between the clinic, the church and the community, translating psychology into language people can use at home, in the pulpit and in the classroom.

[A closing line on what you hope people carry away from your work.]
commitments_title: Four commitments behind everything I do

commitments.title: Clinically grounded
commitments.text: Evidence-based methods, practised with care and professional integrity.

commitments.title: Trauma-informed
commitments.text: Safety first. People are more than what happened to them.

commitments.title: Faith-integrated
commitments.text: Psychology and faith in honest conversation, not in competition.

commitments.title: Culturally rooted
commitments.text: Care that fits Nigerian families, languages and ways of life.
